sql.schedule.getEvents: with start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ), resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 ) select cfg.group_name, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, st.timestamp_value as start, et.timestamp_value as end, r.int_value as resource_id, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.latitude, c.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, c.state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.process_step_id = cfg.process_step_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga1 on cfga1.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga1.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga2.schedule_field_type_id = 2 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga3 on cfga3.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga3.schedule_field_type_id = 3 left join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga1.id left join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga2.id left join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = pps.id and r.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga3.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga3.custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = r.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where cfg.event_type_id is not null and cfg.archived is not true and st.timestamp_value is not null and et.timestamp_value is not null and r.int_value is not null and case when :startTime::date is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::date else 1=1 end and case when :endTime::date is not null then et.timestamp_value <= :endTime::date else 1=1 end and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[coalesce(o.id, -1)] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [coalesce(u.id, -1)] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::BIGINT[] end )
sql.schedule.getAvailability: with dates as ( select :startTime::date + d.date as date, extract(dow from :startTime::date + d.date) + 1 as day_of_week_id from generate_series(0, 99) as d(date) where :startTime::date + d.date BETWEEN :startTime::date and :endTime::date - 1 ) select coalesce(rs.user_id, rs.org_id) as resource_id, (d.date || ' ' || rsa.start_time)::timestamp as "start", (d.date || ' ' || rsa.end_time)::timestamp as "end", rsa.day_of_week_id, false as all_day, null as title, 'inverse-background' as rendering, case when rs.org_id is not null then 1 else 2 end as system_list_type_id from dates d inner join flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa on rsa.day_of_week_id = d.day_of_week_id inner join flow.resource_schedule rs on rs.id = rsa.resource_schedule_id and d.date between rs.start_date and rs.end_date where rs.archived is not true and rsa.archived is not true and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[coalesce(rs.org_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [coalesce(rs.user_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[] end ) union all select coalesce(ra.user_id, ra.org_id) as resource_id, ra.start_time as "start", ra.end_time as "end", null::int, ra.all_day, ra.description as "title", 'background' as rendering, case when ra.org_id is not null then 1 else 2 end as system_list_type_id from flow.resource_appointment ra where ra.start_time >= :startTime::date and ra.end_time <= :endTime::date and ra.archived is not true and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[coalesce(ra.org_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [coalesce(ra.user_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[] end )
sql.schedule.getProjects: with start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 2 ), resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 3 ) select cfg.group_name, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, st.timestamp_value as start, st.id as start_custom_field_value_id, cfga1.id as start_custom_field_group_assignment_id, cf1.field_name as start_field_name, cf1.readonly as start_field_read_only, et.timestamp_value as end, et.id as end_custom_field_value_id, cfga2.id as end_custom_field_group_assignment_id, cf2.field_name as end_field_name, cf2.readonly as end_field_read_only, r.int_value as resource_id, cf3.field_name as resource_field_name, r.id as resource_custom_field_value_id, cfga3.id as resource_custom_field_group_assignment_id, cf3.readonly as resource_field_read_only, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.latitude, c.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, c.state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, case when sl.id is not null then coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sys))) FROM ( select * from flow.get_system_list_options(ps.company_id::integer, sl.id::integer, true, cf3.system_list_option_ids::integer[]) ) sys), '[]') else '[]' end as resources from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga1 on cfga1.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga1.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga2.schedule_field_type_id = 2 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga3 on cfga3.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga3.schedule_field_type_id = 3 left join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga1.id left join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga2.id left join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = pps.id and r.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga3.id left join flow.custom_field cf1 on cf1.id = cfga1.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field cf2 on cf2.id = cfga2.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field cf3 on cf3.id = cfga3.custom_field_id left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf3.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = r.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value where case when :isParent then array[ps.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else ps.company_id = :companyId end and ps.archived is not true and c.state_id = :stateId and cfg.archived is not true and case when st.timestamp_value is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::date else 1=1 end and case when st.timestamp_value is not null then st.timestamp_value <= :endTime::date else 1=1 end and case when array_length(ARRAY[ :eventTypeIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) = 0 OR ARRAY[ :eventTypeIds ]::integer[] is null then 1=1 else ARRAY[coalesce(cfg.event_type_id,-1)] <@ ARRAY[ :eventTypeIds ]::INTEGER[] end

sql.schedule.searchProjectsByName: select c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as contact_full_name, p.project_name, p.id as project_id from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id where c.archived is not true and case when :isParent then array[c.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else c.company_id = :companyId end and c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name ILIKE '%' || :search || '%' order by c.first_name, c.last_name
